create_imitation_wrapper_env: create an ImitationWrapperEnv instance wrapping a LocomotionGymEnv for motion imitation training
step_environment_with_action: step the wrapped environment with a numpy action array and get modified observations
reset_robot_position: reset the robot position with optional initial motor angles and reset duration
build_observation_space: build the observation space by concatenating original and target observations from reference motion
modify_observation_with_target: modify observations by appending target observations from the reference motion to original observations
